description: This file contains a constant-time SSSE3 AES core implementation for x86, including key schedule, encryption, decryption, and CBC mode functions, with references to OpenSSL and specific hardware optimizations.

methods.name: vpaes_set_encrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up encryption key schedule for AES using the vpaes implementation.

methods.name: vpaes_set_decrypt_key
methods.description: Sets up decryption key schedule for AES using the vpaes implementation.

methods.name: vpaes_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on input data using the prepared key schedule.

methods.name: vpaes_decrypt
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on input data using the prepared key schedule.

methods.name: vpaes_cbc_encrypt
methods.description: Performs AES CBC mode encryption or decryption depending on parameters.
